style: Retro-cinematic hybrid battle score for a pixel-art starship game: pounding live drums, taiko and big toms, a driving cello and string ostinato, bright analog synthesizer arpeggios over a deep analog bass, spacious reverb, a bold clean electric guitar and synth lead melody, felt piano and glass bells. A fight among rusted copper relays and green cables above the clouds. Urgent, heroic and melodic, like an epic adventure film score. Purely instrumental. Dm, 110 BPM.
